verse.verse_3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
verse.verse_4: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
verse.verse_5: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
verse.verse_6: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
verse.verse_7: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
verse.verse_8: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
verse.verse_9: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
verse.verse_10: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
verse.verse_11: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
verse.verse_12: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
verse.verse_13: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
verse.verse_14: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
verse.verse_15: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
verse.verse_16: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
verse.verse_17: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
verse.verse_18: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
verse.verse_19: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
verse.verse_20: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
verse.verse_21: Then he will be in blissful state
verse.verse_23: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
verse.verse_24: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
verse.verse_25: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
verse.verse_26: And knew not what my reckoning!
verse.verse_27: Oh, would that it had been death!
verse.verse_28: My wealth hath not availed me,
verse.verse_29: My power hath gone from me.
verse.verse_30: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
verse.verse_31: And then expose him to hell-fire
verse.verse_32: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
verse.verse_33: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
verse.verse_34: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
verse.verse_35: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
verse.verse_38: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
verse.verse_39: And all that ye see not
verse.verse_40: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
verse.verse_41: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
verse.verse_42: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
verse.verse_43: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_44: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
verse.verse_45: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
verse.verse_47: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
verse.verse_48: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
verse.verse_49: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
verse.verse_50: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
verse.verse_51: And lo! it is absolute truth.
verse.verse_52: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
